scope: Depth-only systems-engineering overlay for the breadth-frozen VOL-000..420 masterplan.

engineering_dimensions.name: Requirement testability
engineering_dimensions.rule: Every requirement must be falsifiable or have an explicit evidence method.

engineering_dimensions.name: Interface ownership
engineering_dimensions.rule: Every cross-component interaction names producer, consumer, schema/version and compatibility policy.

engineering_dimensions.name: State authority
engineering_dimensions.rule: Authoritative state, projections, transitions and concurrency semantics must be explicit.

engineering_dimensions.name: Authority and trust
engineering_dimensions.rule: Identity, capability, policy, trust labels and privilege boundaries survive normalization and delegation.

engineering_dimensions.name: Failure containment
engineering_dimensions.rule: Timeout, retry, partial failure, overload and dependency failure behavior is bounded and testable.

engineering_dimensions.name: Recovery
engineering_dimensions.rule: Checkpoint, replay, rollback, restore, compensation and terminal-state behavior are defined where applicable.

engineering_dimensions.name: Quantitative budgets
engineering_dimensions.rule: Applicable latency, throughput, durability, availability, resource, cost and quality budgets have units, environment and measurement method before production promotion.

engineering_dimensions.name: Capacity and backpressure
engineering_dimensions.rule: Queues, concurrency, memory/storage growth and fan-out have explicit ceilings and load-shed behavior.

engineering_dimensions.name: Compatibility and migration
engineering_dimensions.rule: Schema/API/config/storage/model compatibility, migration and rollback windows are declared.

engineering_dimensions.name: Observability
engineering_dimensions.rule: Critical transitions, denials, retries, degradation and recovery emit reconstructable telemetry.

engineering_dimensions.name: Evaluation
engineering_dimensions.rule: Probabilistic capabilities have versioned datasets, baselines, budgets and acceptance thresholds.

engineering_dimensions.name: Reproducibility
engineering_dimensions.rule: Build/test/eval evidence records code, config, dependency, data/model and environment identity.

engineering_dimensions.name: Release and rollback
engineering_dimensions.rule: Promotion, canary, rollback and incompatibility stop conditions are explicit.

engineering_dimensions.name: Ownership and impact
engineering_dimensions.rule: Code, schema, config, tests, runbooks and change-impact triggers have accountable owners.

budget_binding_policy.rule: Do not invent universal numeric thresholds in the plan. Before implementation can be promoted beyond scaffolded/experimental, each applicable budget class must bind a threshold with unit, percentile/window where relevant, workload, environment, measurement method, owner and exception policy.
budget_binding_policy.production_rule: Production evidence must contain measured values against the bound threshold; target text alone is not evidence.

compatibility_policy.rule: Any cross-boundary contract change must declare additive/breaking semantics, reader/writer compatibility, migration order, rollback window and mixed-version behavior.
forbidden: one-way migration without declared rollback/restore strategy
consumer upgrade assumed atomic across distributed components

failure_policy.rule: Every package must model dependency failure, timeout, duplicate/replay, overload, partial completion, cancellation and restart where applicable.

evidence_policy.rule: Planned tests/evals are design intent only. Evidence must point to a concrete run/artifact bound to git SHA, configuration and environment.

work_package_profiles.name: Architecture authority
work_package_profiles.promotion_rule: No verified/hardened/production promotion until applicable dimensions have concrete artifacts, measured thresholds where quantitative, executable evidence, and accountability references.
